headline: On last trading day, Sensex plunged 989 points while Nifty slipped below 25,650 amid HDFC Bank and IT sell-off.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 30 November.

why: Heavy selling in HDFC Bank and the IT sector pressured the major indices.
Bears dominated the session as the Sensex crashed nearly 1,000 points in a single day.
Negative global cues and lingering concerns over potential Fed interest rate hikes impacted sentiment.
Profit booking by investors followed a two-day winning streak earlier in the week.
whatHappening: Sensex closed at 25,600 levels while Nifty finished below the 25,650 mark on Friday.
The Bombay High Court cleared the path for a Tata Sons board meeting on November 30.
Gold prices rebounded from 15-month lows, and silver prices surged nearly 6 percent.
Market volatility increased as the indices erased gains made during the previous two sessions.
summary:
Friday's session saw a sharp decline with the Sensex plunging 989 points and Nifty slipping below 25,650.
The market was dragged down by heavy selling in HDFC Bank and IT stocks, ending a brief two-day rally.
Investors are now looking toward Monday's reopening and the scheduled Tata Sons board meeting for further cues.
